title: High Molecular Gas Masses in Absorption-selected Galaxies at z ≍ 2
question: Do high-metallicity z~2 DLAs host CO-emitting galaxies with high molecular gas masses, and do absorption-selected galaxies match emission-selected samples?

what.value: DLA metallicities, N_HI, Delta V90 and references per DLA

external_data.citation: berg15; neeleman13; krogager16; petitjean02; fynbo10; fynbo13

what.value: Emission metallicity vs stellar mass of UV-selected galaxies

evidence.quote: the stellar mass for the (binned) UV-selected galaxies of (cite: erb06)

recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration, self-cal for three sources, uvsub continuum subtraction, natural-weighted cubes
Spectrum from cut through dirty cube at peak pixel of velocity-integrated emission (unresolved); limits from 200 km/s cubes
Convert CO flux to L'CO, apply R13/R14 to CO(1-0), multiply by alpha_CO
Assume Mmol/M*≈1 to get stellar mass; plot DLA metallicity vs M* against Erb06

answer_key.quantity: Molecular gas masses of five CO detections
3 sigma upper limits on Mmol for non-detections

not_stated_but_needed: Image size and cell size, CLEAN depth/masking
How CO FWHM and integrated flux and uncertainties were measured (fit form)
missing_for_reproduction: Line-fitting procedure for flux and FWHM
L'CO conversion details beyond cited formula
score_reason: Public data and simple, numeric recipe, but imaging and line measurement details are sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, natural-weighted cubes, numeric flux and mass results in tables.
